summary.text: Wlnsvey Campos is a Democratic member of the Oregon State Senate for District 18, which her biography says includes Aloha, South Hillsboro and Beaverton.
She was elected to the Senate in 2022 and previously represented House District 28.

paragraphs.text: Campos was raised in Bandon, Oregon, by a single father in a low-income household, according to her biography, and is the daughter of immigrants.
She first took office on January 11, 2021, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to the Oregon House, and in 2022 became the youngest state senator in Oregon history, the page says.
She has worked as a housing case manager and currently works to support school-based health systems.
She is co-chair of the Ways and Means Human Services subcommittee and a former vice chair of the House Housing Committee.
